summary: Without the TransformUtilities.cs edit the generator emits `{#if !NETSTANDARD2_0 && !NETFRAMEWORK` on one line for the formatter nested in a constrained generic type, which fails to compile with 1 error CS1040; the Ordinal formatter loses the 1 extra blank line, so that blank line is a side effect of the edit

details.why_a_second_file: transformutilities-removal.json (script) only shows the snapshot mismatch; the test framework stops at the file-content check, before the compiler diagnostics. This hand run skips the content check in a scratch copy to see the compiler result and the real output.

compiler_diagnostics.message: Preprocessor directives must appear as the first non-whitespace character on a line

actual_output_vs_committed_branch_snapsh.meaning: StringKeyFormatterTemplate writes its first line right after the nesting `{`; with constraints, TransformUtilities wrote `{` with no line break, so the new `#if` is not at line start
FormatterTemplate already writes a line break after the nesting block, so the edit's extra `\r\n` yields one blank line

by_reading_not_run.also_needs_edit: UnionTemplate (writes `#if` directly after the nesting `{`, like StringKeyFormatterTemplate)
